sections.title: Peace Process with Customers; Acknowledging Human and System Errors

summary: In this brief talk, Jeanne Bliss argues that how a company apologizes when something goes wrong reveals its true character more than any other moment. The message centers on using apology to remove pain and resolve problems as a storytelling device that defines the brand. She elevates grace and wisdom over accusations or deflection, reframing missteps as opportunities to demonstrate accountability and care. The talk introduces a “peace process” concept: a constructive, ongoing effort to repair trust between the company and its customers. It acknowledges that human beings design processes and that both human error and software errors are inevitable, underscoring that transparent, compassionate responses are essential to maintaining trust when things go wrong.
title: Your Values Are On Stage When You Make a Mistake
topics: crisis leadership with grace and wisdom
peace process between customers and company
human error in people and systems
